decisions.reason: As a perfect binder close to the core finishing portfolio, it fits the firm's stated direction and prior visible commitment, so management would be inclined to continue it and view any weak traction as temporary in a growing market.

The fully automatic perfect binder directly supports the firm's automation and productivity promise, and escalation of commitment makes management likely to persist with a product that is strategically central and already publicly offered.

The booklet maker for inline and nearline applications is strongly aligned with digital print finishing, so despite limited public evidence after launch, management would likely retain it rather than reverse course on a core-category offering.
